chat.title: MindMate
chat.statusIdle: Here whenever you want to talk
chat.greeting: Hi, I am MindMate. I am an AI, not a human, and I am here to listen and help you find one small next step. How are you feeling right now?
chat.placeholder: Jo bhi mann mein hai, yahan likho... (private rakha jaata hai)
chat.disclaimer: MindMate is an AI that offers student wellbeing guidance. It is not a doctor and does not diagnose. In a crisis, call Tele-MANAS 14416, KIRAN 1800-599-0019 or 112.
chat.degradedBody: The AI companion cannot be reached, so replies are paused. Nothing is being made up in its place. You can still use breathing, your safety plan, or book a counsellor below.
chat.rateLimited: You are sending messages very quickly. Please take a breath and try again in a minute.
chat.sendError: That message did not go through. Please try again.

chips.label: Suggested actions
chips.bookingHint: You can book a confidential session from Counsellors in the menu.

starters.label: Conversation starters
starters.overwhelmed: Main bahut overwhelmed feel kar raha hoon
starters.focus: Padhai mein focus nahi ho raha

crisis.title: You matter, and you do not have to face this alone
crisis.body: What you shared sounds very painful. Please talk to a trained person right now. These services are free, confidential and open 24/7.
crisis.counsellorSent: Your counsellor has been alerted and will reach out.
crisis.counsellorFailed: We could not alert a counsellor. Please call a helpline above or book a session.
crisis.continue: I have read this, continue chatting
crisis.paused: Chat is paused while you look at the support options above.
crisis.pinned: This support card stays visible for the rest of this session.

chat.notSaved: Saved for 30 days, encrypted with your vault passphrase. MindSahaay staff and counsellors cannot read it. Each message is still sent to our AI provider to write a reply.
chat.lockedBanner: Unlock your vault to save and see past conversations. This conversation is not being saved.
chat.notSavedThisConvo: This conversation is not being saved.
chat.demoNotice: Preview mode: conversations are not saved.

freeTier.banner: Demo mode: messages go to Google's free Gemini service, may be read by human reviewers and used to improve Google products. Do not enter real or identifying information.
freeTier.gate: Before you chat: this demo sends your messages to a free Google service. Please type only made-up or test messages, nothing real or identifying. Crisis helplines still work: Tele-MANAS 14416, KIRAN 1800-599-0019, Emergency 112.

chat.deleteConvoConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this conversation? This cannot be undone.
chat.deleteAllChatsConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete all saved conversations? This cannot be undone.
